We need to produce test cases for exception scenarios of removeAllRecords. The existing test cases already cover IllegalArgumentException for invalid sections. Are there any other exception scenarios? Let's inspect method:

public void removeAllRecords(int section) {
    Section.check(section);
    sections[section] = null;
    header.setCount(section, 0);
}

Potential NPE if sections array is null, or header is null. But in class, sections and header presumably initialized in constructor. However, if someone creates Message and manually sets header to null or sections to null via reflection? Not typical. But exception scenarios might include NullPointerException if header is null. Also IndexOutOfBoundsException if sections array length less than section but Section.check passes? Section.check likely ensures 0-3 inclusive. So sections array length should be at least 4. But if sections array itself is null, then sections[section] throws NPE. Also header.setCount may throw NullPointerException if header null. So we can design tests to trigger NPE by mocking or using reflection to set fields to null.

Also IllegalArgumentException already covered.

Any other exception: maybe SecurityException? Not.
